feature_flags.MATCH_FEAT_AUTO_APPLY_ENABLED: RESERVED: code reads CFG.MATCH_FEAT_AUTO_APPLY_ENABLED, but config mapping may be missing; treat as false unless wired
feature_flags.ANALYTICS_ENABLED: DB events tracking (keep false to save Neon)
feature_flags.AUDIT_DB_THROTTLE_ENABLED: Throttle noisy workspace audit INSERTs (Redis gate)
feature_flags.AUDIT_DB_THROTTLE_LIMIT: Max allowed audit writes per window
feature_flags.TRACE_REDIS_ENABLED: Optional short-lived Redis trace for debugging
feature_flags.SUPPORT_CHAT_ID: Operator group chat id for support tickets + ops alerts (optional; falls back to SUPER_ADMIN_TG_IDS).
feature_flags.OPS_ALERT_SILENT: Quiet mode for ops alerts (only error/failed).
feature_flags.OPS_ALERT_BUFFER_MAX: Max buffered ops events (Redis list cap).
feature_flags.CONTACT_UNLOCK_COST: Brand Pass: credits cost to unlock contacts (default 1).
feature_flags.PAYMENTS_FALLBACK_APPLY_ENABLED: Apply payments by invoice_payload if pay_* session expired (anti-ORPHANED).

brand_profile.why: Keep main menu clean; owner settings live with profile

home_hub.why: Single entrypoint; ui_mode in Redis controls which mode is shown

ops_observability.health: /api/health returns cron last_run + audit throttle counters + ops alert status (Redis-only; no DB)
ops_observability.cron: giveaways_tick + broadcast_tick store last_run summary in Redis
ops_observability.support_ops_chat: SUPPORT_CHAT_ID receives user support tickets + ops alerts; admins can reply via ✍️ Ответить (reply to bot prompt) or 1-click templates.
